fullPassage: A serious deterioration in people’s working lives would be deeply disturbing to the social order. Indeed few consequences of technological change would be as dangerous. Today, the world of work is the main way that we share out the fruits of growth for most people, their job is their main, if not their only, source of income. Technological unemployment would weaken that longstanding arrangement, encouraging an even more extreme version of inequality in which some people receive more income than others and many receive nothing at all Nor would the disturbance be only economic. For many people, their work is both a source of income and (a source) of meaning.
